method: Primary WHATWG snapshot inspected using web read tools; no fixture imported or executed.

S301.finding: Ready epochs change on pressure transitions; successful write completion releases its queued weight. In-flight weight remains counted.

S302.finding: Start fulfillment enables callback admission. Initial readiness depends on pressure, independently of initialization completion.

S303.finding: A close request resolves existing pressure readiness before outstanding write and close callbacks finish.

S304.finding: Readable demand relieves initial HWM0 backpressure; output consumption without another pending read restores it.

S305.finding: Flush fulfillment precedes readable closure and sink-close completion. Prefix read must accompany write under HWM0.

S306.finding: Pull admission uses weighted desired size or pending read demand, after start. Pull completion alone does not permit refill at zero capacity.
